682:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...First, let us share our joy at having reached the galactic center.」

682:t_1:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But the battle ahead is the mission entrusted to us.」

682:t_1:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Our final operation against $$バアル$$... the $$宇宙怪獣$$... will begin in 48 hours.」

682:t_1:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「According to information from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, the vast numbers of $$宇宙怪獣$$ have appeared in sectors throughout the galaxy and begun their invasion.」

682:t_1:13.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So their all-out attack is getting underway...」

682:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As the damage spreads, observations show distortions gradually forming in the universe.」

682:t_1:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「You could also call them distortions of dimensional boundaries over an enormous area.」

682:t_1:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「Does that mean a $$時空震動$$ encompassing the entire universe is going to occur?!」

682:t_1:18.en:
$$桂$$
「In other words, a collapse of space-time... So that's the universe's great collapse that occurs once every 120 million years.」

682:t_1:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「Probably... And the point where those distortions converge is the gravitational anomaly at the galactic center... the so-called $$グレートアトラクター$$.」

682:t_1:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「The $$グレートアトラクター$$... So that's the heart of the great collapse...」

682:t_1:21.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Is there a connection between the $$宇宙怪獣$$' all-out attack and the distortions in the universe happening in sync?」

682:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The key to that lies in the space-time repair $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ attempted.」

682:t_1:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「He was going to reshape the world however he wished... by forcibly repairing space-time...」

682:t_1:25.en:
$$トライア$$
「It looks like some of you have realized it.」

682:t_1:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He intended to do it after reducing the living humans... the power of life, which would resist the repair of space-time.」

682:t_1:27.en:
$$万丈$$
「By erasing living beings, he would weaken the power of life and cause a $$時空震動$$... So the universe's great collapse works the same way...」

682:t_1:28.en:
$$葵$$
「The force that seeks to exist and the force that seeks to vanish... So the life in this universe produces the force that seeks to exist.」

682:t_1:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「Strictly speaking, the power of life doesn't belong only to living organisms.」

682:t_1:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「Everything that exists has a will governing it. Ultimately, even this world's natural order and laws can be said to arise from the will of that power to exist.」

682:t_1:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I'll explain that another time. It's important, so I want to take my time with it...」

682:t_1:33.en:
$$トライア$$
「But first, we need to deal with the situation in front of us.」

682:t_1:34.en:
$n
(Even things other than living organisms have the power of life...)

682:t_1:35.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And the $$宇宙怪獣$$ lay their eggs in stars...」

682:t_1:36.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I've heard that stars are masses of dimensional energy. So they're also concentrations of the power of life.」

682:t_1:37.en:
$$號$$
「By annihilating living beings and stars, they weaken the force that seeks to exist, and its counterpart, the force that seeks to vanish, swallows the universe...」

682:t_1:38.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So that's the universe's great collapse.」

682:t_1:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Could the $$御使い$$s' destruction of galaxies also...」

682:t_1:40.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yes... It probably works by the same mechanism.」

682:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「The 'preparations' they spoke of meant taking the lives of those living there...」

682:t_1:42.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So those $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$s and $$エル・ミレニウム$$s are the forces they use for that...」

682:t_1:43.en:
$$シモン$$
「Damn it...! Everything about those bastards makes me sick!」

682:t_1:44.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Set the $$御使い$$s aside for now. Concentrate on our battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

682:t_1:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've been wondering for a while. What does that force that seeks to vanish actually want to do?」

682:t_1:48.en:
$$勝平$$
「I've wondered that too! If everything vanishes, that force that seeks to vanish disappears too, right?」

682:t_1:49.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Exactly! What's the point of that?!」

682:t_1:50.en:
$$隼人$$
「It is an existence that does not exist... In other words, it's nothingness...」

682:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Unfortunately, I can't answer $$ワッ太$$'s or $$勝平$$'s questions either.」

682:t_1:53.en:
$$トライア$$
「Answering that would take us into the realm of philosophy...」

682:t_1:54.en:
$$トライア$$
「But my own interpretation is that nothingness is also a kind of will.」

682:t_1:56.en:
$$トライア$$
「In other words, even in a world where the force that seeks to vanish has erased everything, the will of the one who wished for that would remain.」

682:t_1:58.en:
$$トライア$$
「Something exists even though there is nothing... It is the transcendent existence of whoever can perceive that existence... It's hard both to explain and to understand.」

682:t_1:59.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「'I think, therefore I am'... Is that it...?」

682:t_1:60.en:
$$キラ$$
「If the force that seeks to vanish is a will, is it some kind of living creature?」

682:t_1:61.en:
$$トライア$$
「Who knows... At least, it would be different from living creatures as we understand them.」

682:t_1:62.en:
$$トライア$$
「If I had to call it something, I might say... the will of the universe.」

682:t_1:63.en:
$$シン$$
「Then does the universe itself create $$宇宙怪獣$$ because it wants to disappear?!」

682:t_1:64.en:
$n
「...I think it wants to be reborn, more than it wants to disappear...」

682:t_1:66.en:
$$トライア$$
「Just as $n said. The universe probably wants to die once so it can be reborn.」

682:t_1:67.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though what it wants that for is another matter.」

682:t_1:68.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's leave the complicated stuff there. We live in this universe, and we can't just get out because it decides it wants us gone.」

682:t_1:69.en:
$$アルト$$
「We have to stop the great collapse to save the life that exists here.」

682:t_1:70.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's why we've come all this way.」

682:t_1:71.en:
$$葵$$
「Even if we're up against the universe itself, let's do this.」

682:t_1:72.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're here as representatives of all living things, prepared to challenge the universe.」

682:t_1:73.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Exactly. That's why we're fighting.」

682:t_1:74.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our allies will include the ultra-long-distance emigration fleets we previously approached, starting with the $$マクロス７船団$$, and...」

682:t_1:75.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The forces of the planets formerly under the $$ギシン星$$ system's rule will also join the operation, thanks to $$ロゼ$$'s mediation.」

682:t_1:76.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we'd had a little more time, we could have contacted people from more star systems and asked for their help...」

682:t_1:77.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems the other star systems don't know how the universe's great collapse works.」

682:t_1:78.en:
$$タケル$$
「So that's why they're concentrating on defending their own planets...」

682:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「What is $$サイデリアル$$ doing? They should also have been fighting $$バアル$$ in the galactic core.」

682:t_1:80.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Judging from their movements, they appear to have suffered repeated routs and grown considerably weaker.」

682:t_1:81.en:
$$シャア$$
「I believe their chain of command fell into disarray when their ruler, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, defected.」

682:t_1:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You mean $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$...」
